label: Web Scraper (Firecrawl)
description: Turns the web into clean, AI-ready data via the Firecrawl v2 API. Five operations: scrape a single URL, crawl a whole site, map a site's URLs, run a web/news/image search, or run an Agent extraction (structured data from a prompt/schema; the v2 replacement for the deprecated /extract endpoint).

config.name: operation
config.description: Which Firecrawl v2 operation to run.

config.name: url
config.description: Target / starting URL. Required for scrape, crawl and map.

config.name: query
config.description: Search query. Required for the search operation.

config.name: formats
config.description: Scrape output formats (v2). `json` = structured extraction (uses jsonPrompt/jsonFields); `question` = a grounded natural-language answer (uses the question field); `highlights` = matching sentences/blocks.

config.name: onlyMainContent
config.description: Return only the main content area.

config.name: waitFor
config.description: Delay (ms) before scraping to allow client-side rendering.

config.name: timeout
config.description: Scrape timeout (ms).

config.name: isMobile
config.description: Use a mobile viewport/user-agent (scrape).

config.name: includeTags
config.description: HTML tags/selectors to include (scrape).

config.name: excludeTags
config.description: HTML tags/selectors to exclude (scrape).

config.name: jsonPrompt
config.description: Natural-language instructions for the `json` format's structured extraction.

config.name: jsonFields
config.description: Schema fields ({ name, type }) for the `json` format; compiled into a JSON Schema.

config.name: question
config.description: The question to answer against the page when the `question` format is selected.

config.name: limit
config.description: Max pages to crawl (crawl).

config.name: includePaths
config.description: Only crawl URLs matching these path patterns (crawl).

config.name: excludePaths
config.description: Skip URLs matching these path patterns (crawl).

config.name: crawlEntireDomain
config.description: Follow links across the whole domain, including parent/sibling paths (crawl).

config.name: sitemap
config.description: How to use the site's sitemap.xml (crawl/map).

config.name: maxDiscoveryDepth
config.description: Max link-discovery depth from the start URL (crawl).

config.name: mapSearch
config.description: Filter discovered URLs by this term (map).

config.name: mapLimit
config.description: Max URLs to return (map).

config.name: includeSubdomains
config.description: Include subdomains in discovery (map).

config.name: sources
config.description: Which result sources to search (search).

config.name: categories
config.description: Optional category filters (search).

config.name: searchLimit
config.description: Max search results (search).

config.name: searchScrape
config.description: Also scrape full page content for each search result (search).

config.name: location
config.description: Geographic location bias for search results.

config.name: agentPrompt
config.description: Extraction prompt for the Agent operation (v2 /agent, replaces the deprecated /extract).

config.name: agentFields
config.description: Schema fields ({ name, type }) for the Agent extraction; compiled into a JSON Schema.

config.name: agentUrls
config.description: Optional seed URLs to ground the Agent extraction.

produces.reference: [Input from {id}] for the main content; [[json.<field>] from {id}] or [[agent.<field>] from {id}] for structured extraction
produces.note: scrape/crawl/map/search return content referenced as [Input from {id}]. When formats include 'json' (or the Agent operation) the extracted object is reachable as [[json.<field>] from {id}] / [[agent.<field>] from {id}].
